summary: A Founders Club blog post dated February 7, 2022 explains how the compass direction a room faces affects its natural light, covering north, south, east and west orientations. It notes benefits of natural light such as energy conservation, better vision and mood, alongside risks like heat gain and glare, and advises planning room placement with an architect and builder. The post closes by promoting The Founders Club's oversized Sarasota home sites and preferred builders.
one_line: A Founders Club blog guide to how north, south, east and west room orientation shapes natural light in custom homes.
key_facts: The blog post 'How Room Orientation Affects Natural Light in Your Custom Homes' was dated February 7, 2022.
Benefits of letting natural light into a home include energy conservation, improved vision and mood, and natural views.
Too much natural light can cause heat gain/loss and create unsightly glares.
North-facing rooms provide soft, indirect light and are typically the darkest rooms in a home in terms of natural lighting.
North-facing rooms are described as having the most predictable natural lighting, making them a great area to hang art.
North-facing rooms are said to need horizontal shading to prevent excessive heat in the summer.
South-facing rooms are described as the brightest in the house since they bring in warmer light.
South-facing orientation is best for rooms not used as frequently, such as a garage, a laundry room, a work room, or stairs.
East-facing rooms let the light in during the morning hours but the afternoon light is more dull when the sun is overhead.
East-facing rooms are described as a great place for kitchen and breakfast areas.
West-facing rooms have the strongest light in the late afternoon and early evening.
The post advises adding vertical shading to west-facing rooms to minimize overheating and glare in the afternoon.
Estate home sites in The Founders Club range from a half acre to one acre.
The Founders Club works with five preferred Sarasota home builders to create luxury custom homes.
The Founders Club's address is 3001 Founders Club Drive, Sarasota, FL 34240.
